## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue when applicable.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their actual results, including any limitations.

## Review

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no credentials or personal paths.
- [ ] Relevant tests and checks pass.
- [ ] Public behavior changes are reflected in the README and Unreleased changelog, when applicable.
- [ ] Metric changes include independent expected results, coverage behavior, and version updates, when applicable.
